description: Edison International was incorporated in 1987 as the parent holding company of Southern California Edison Company, a California public utility incorporated in 1909, and it also owns Trio, a global energy advisory firm providing integrated sustainability and energy solutions to commercial, industrial and institutional customers. Its principal executive office is located at 2244 Walnut Grove Avenue in Rosemead, California, and it files a combined Annual Report on Form 10-K with Southern California Edison Company.
